private pure subroutine basis_bspline_ders(Xt, knot, nc, degree, nder, B, dB, d2B)

Scatter local values and derivatives into optional dense vectors. Every present output has length nc; entries outside local support are set to zero.

real(kind=rk), intent(out), optional :: d2B(nc)
